title: The Danube
about: its length, the countries it flows through and the sea it flows into. Include several specific numbers, dates or names where the topic has them, some exact and some rounded or hedged (about, nearly, more than, up to).
passages: The Danube is one of the great rivers of Europe, stretching about 2,850 kilometers, or nearly 1,770 miles. Only the Volga in Russia is longer on the continent. It begins in the Black Forest of Germany, near the town of Donaueschingen, where two small streams meet in a CONFLUENCE. From there it travels east through ten countries: Germany, Austria, Slovakia, Hungary, Croatia, Serbia, Romania, Bulgaria, Moldova and Ukraine. No other river in the world passes through so many. Along the way it flows past four capital cities, Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest and Belgrade, each with its own bridges, languages and food.

Between Serbia and Romania, the river squeezes through a narrow, rocky GORGE called the Iron Gates, where cliffs rise high above the water. Further on, it reaches the Black Sea, spreading into a huge DELTA of channels, reeds and islands shared by Romania and Ukraine. The delta became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1991, and more than 300 kinds of birds live there or pass through, including pelicans. People along the Danube have long celebrated it in music. In 1867, a famous WALTZ by Johann Strauss II called "The Blue Danube" was first performed in Vienna, and dancers still twirl to it today.
